description: SAR dashboards with filters for time/date, host/CVM, interface, Rx/Tx packets, errors/drops, and disk.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cpu == "all")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pct_usr" or r._field == "pct_sys" or r._field == "pct_iowait" or r._field == "pct_idle" or r._field == "pct_soft" or r._field == "pct_irq")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_load")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ldavg_1" or r._field == "ldavg_5" or r._field == "ldavg_15" or r._field == "blocked")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pct_memused" or r._field == "pct_commit")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "kbmemfree" or r._field == "kbmemused" or r._field == "kbcached" or r._field == "kbavail")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

panels.title: Disk I/O — tps / await / util / rkB / wkB (filter disk)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sar")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sar_disk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /${host:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev =~ /${disk:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tps" or r._field == "await" or r._field == "pct_util" or r._field == "rkB_s" or r._field == "wkB_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
